text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to contain her excitement, Mejiro 
Dober is eager for everyone to see the way 
she runs right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind reassuring words promising 
to exceed even the Trainer's expectations, 
she headed into the race.
